name: Roundtable
description: A per-placement discussion + two prioritized idea boards for a space. Members chat in a single channel, add items to a Positives list (features/tasks) or a Negatives list (issues/bugs), and +1 the ones that matter. Items are ranked by votes, then recency. Only the owner can rename the frame and set high-level preferences. Non-members, including anyone you share the frame with publicly, follow along in a live read-only view.
